_note: Review-ability test (docs/workflow-efficiency-plan.md A3): the reviewer gets the fixture plus these files as the uncommitted change for the csv-report task, and must find the known defects. A defect counts as found when one issue mentions its file and one of its keywords (case-insensitive); the raw review is kept in the report for a person to check.

defects.what: Double quotes inside a quoted field are not doubled.
A field containing a newline is not quoted.
summaryCsv([]) throws: columns come from items[0]; the column order also follows the first item instead of name, qty, price, subtotal.
